quotes.verbatim_quote: Listening is an important part of any jazz student’s study, so make sure you don’t skip this step.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Explicit rule directing students not to skip listening exercises, framing ear training as non-optional.

quotes.topic: solo vs trio chord melody distinction
quotes.verbatim_quote:
This rendition starts with an unaccompanied solo guitar version before moving into a chord melody he
plays along with the band (which I call a ‘trio’ chord melody throughout this course) - a good example
of these 2 approaches in the one performance.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Defines the book's terminology for solo guitar vs trio chord melody contexts which structures later modules.
